summary: North American Construction Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, announcing via press release its second quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call schedule. The filing provides the date of results (August 12, 2026), conference call and webcast details for August 13, 2026, and dial-in/replay information. This is a routine earnings notification with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. There are no deal terms or transaction details disclosed.
